method: Live sessions' slow_end records with the provider's cost_usd and >30k cached-read tokens. Each call is priced at Sonnet 5 and Opus 5.5 list rates (input 3/4, output 15/20, cache read 0.30/0.20, cache write 3.75/5.00 USD per million tokens); the provider computes cost_usd from the model that actually served, so the closer price identifies the served model.
